description: Unit tests for QuicheLinkedHashMap implementation, testing move semantics, emplace, iteration, erase, insertion, and other functionalities.

classes.name: NoCopy
classes.description: A class that cannot be copied or moved, used to test emplacing move-only types into the map.

methods.name: Move
methods.description: Tests that the move constructor of QuicheLinkedHashMap works correctly.

methods.name: CanEmplaceMoveOnly
methods.description: Tests emplacing move-only types into the map.

methods.name: CanEmplaceNoMoveNoCopy
methods.description: Tests emplacing objects that are neither copyable nor movable.

methods.name: ConstKeys
methods.description: Verifies that keys are const during iteration.

methods.name: Iteration
methods.description: Tests forward iteration over the map.

methods.name: ReverseIteration
methods.description: Tests reverse iteration over the map.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Verifies size() reports correct number of elements.

methods.name: Empty
methods.description: Checks that empty() correctly reports if the map is empty.

methods.name: Erase2
methods.description: Tests erasing multiple elements and iteration after erasure.

methods.name: Erase3
methods.description: Tests erasing a range of elements using iterators.

methods.name: Insertion
methods.description: Tests inserting elements and duplicate insert behavior.

methods.name: Front
methods.description: Tests front() accessors and pop_front() functionality.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Tests find() method for existing and non-existing elements.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if the map contains specific keys.

methods.name: Swap
methods.description: Tests swapping contents of two maps.

methods.name: CustomHashAndEquality
methods.description: Tests custom hash functions and equality comparators.
